scope: 12 category facts, 7 single-source Wiki gameplay re-quotes; no independent summary promotion, mechanics inference or strict completion.

summaryRepairs.name: Domination
summaryRepairs.quote: Mash the button for 10 seconds to set up a line of Whomps, then watch them fall like dominoes!

summaryRepairs.name: Granite Getaway
summaryRepairs.quote: Get away from the giant boulder. Jump over or go around the rubble to safely reach the goal.

summaryRepairs.name: Stamp Out!
summaryRepairs.quote: Stamp your color onto the paper to cover as much as you can.

summaryRepairs.name: Snow Brawl
summaryRepairs.quote: Snowball fight! It's one against three, but the Ukikis will help the solo player.

summaryRepairs.name: Defuse or Lose
summaryRepairs.quote: Ground Pound the sparks to extinguish them and delay the explosion.

summaryRepairs.name: Jump the Gun
summaryRepairs.quote: Work together to reach the goal. One player fires Bullet Bills to create a path while the other player jumps across.

summaryRepairs.name: Prize Drop
summaryRepairs.quote: Drop the medal and try to get the item you want.

extractionLimits: Eight known-URL Exa extracts were candidates and default-truncated; full context and A/B proof came from actual native HTTPS captures. No new Exa searches; historical 22-result accounting is not represented as a retained search ledger.
